chapter.heading: Psalm 15
Who Shall Dwell on Your Holy Hill?
A Psalm of David.
chapter.v:
O LORD,
who shall,
sojourn in your tent? Who shall dwell on your holy hill?

who does
not put,
out his money at interest and does not take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be moved. (ESV)
